title: run.skill.md: no-preferred-patch-file rubric criterion is stale; patch_file should be preferred for targeted edits
description: The no-preferred-patch-file rubric criterion was introduced by moeb.deprecate-patch-file-as-default-write-path when patch_file used fragile diffy/unified-diff patching. After moeb.patch-file-exact-string-rewrite, patch_file performs deterministic exact-string substring replacement, making it reliable and well-suited for targeted edits. The criterion is now stale: (1) it penalises agents for using patch_file even for appropriate single-location edits; (2) Phase 3 of run.skill.md contains a hedge discouraging patch_file that predates the exact-string rewrite. Signal d1e2f3a4 proposed removing the patch_file preference from Phase 3 in favour of unconditional write_file, but given the exact-string rewrite the correct resolution is the opposite direction: restore patch_file as the preferred tool for targeted modifications.
proposed_resolution: Remove the no-preferred-patch-file rubric criterion from run.skill.md's rubric section. Update Phase 3 guidance to recommend patch_file as the preferred tool for targeted modifications (changes to existing file content), reserving write_file for full file creation or complete rewrites. This aligns with patch_file's current exact-string semantics and eliminates the friction caused by the stale deprecation. Signal d1e2f3a4 (open, Major) is superseded by this signal and should be closed when this signal's spec is executed.
